messages:
maria: quick heads-up — I want to propose changing how we meter embeddings. currently we bill/route on per-vector count. proposal: switch to a hybrid SLO+ratecard that charges by dimension-weighted units (dims * vectors) and uses a soft quota for very large single requests. want feedback on routing, telemetry, and console signals before we can canary this.

josh: are we sure customers won't freak out? billing model changes are always messy. can we keep backwards-compatible header that indicates which billing model to use? :grimacing:

samir: the technical win is we better align cost with GPU work (more dims == more FLOPs). operationally we need routing to prefer low-dim variants under contention. suggest adaptive batching + a fastpath for <256 dims. :thinking:

elaine: dashboard question — ops/fin want a one-click view of "expected cost impact" per tenant. can we surface: current avg dims, 95p batch size, projected delta? also need drift alerts when avg dims increases >20% week-over-week.

maria: yes — that drift alert is critical. telemetry-wise we need a new metric `embed.dimension_units` and tag it by model, route, and tenant. also capture `ingress.shape_hint` if present.

tyler: operational concern: large payloads (huge vectors or many vectors) still cause 413s or OOMs in the sharder. what's the plan for graceful degradation? throttles? earlyfastfail?

maria: plan: soft quota + telemetry + adaptive-credit bucket. If request exceeds soft quota, route to slow-path with quota metadata and emit `embed.rewrite_hint` in response. clients can opt-in to auto-split.

kevin: can we add a cheap preflight header so we don't have to parse payloads for the router? propose `X-Embed-Shape: n=32,d=768` — router uses it to pick route and estimate cost. fallback: if header missing, do a light parse and emit `shape_detected=true`.

josh: adding header is easy for SDKs. public-api compatibility note: document as optional, not required. also need to specify failure modes: missing or lying header -> we reconcile in billing with server-side detection.

samir: telemetry: we should emit a small sampling of request bodies for debugging (not PII) — just shapes and timing. also histogram for `batch_pack_time` and `kernel_run_ms`.

elaine: UX for console: show "bill estimate" per request in traces, not just per-minute aggregates. also add a toggle to simulate new ratecard so sales can show customers impacts.

maria: rollout plan: feature flag `embed_ratecard_v2` with canary on internal orgs, then 1% production, 10%, etc. telemetry check gates: no more than 0.5% latency regression at p95 and no more than 3% error increase.

tyler: add one more gate: 413s due to routing mis-prediction must not increase >0.2% absolute.

kevin: snippet for header we can use in SDKs:
```\n// JS SDK\nclient.embed({\n  vectors: [...],\n  headers: { 'X-Embed-Shape': 'n=12,d=1536' }\n})\n```

opsbot: deploy scheduled: feature flag `embed_ratecard_v2` created (maria) — canary window set to 24h once enabled.

josh: ok. next steps: write telemetry schema, dashboard mockups, and update SDKs for header. I'll pair with elaine on the console mock.

maria: thanks — I'll open the RFC and link the canary playbook. if anyone's got more hot concerns call them out here. :+1:
